scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && eslint src test scripts
scripts.install:jsdom: npm run build && npm run install:jsdom:run
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:unit:run
scripts.test:artifact:run: node test/artifact/cjs.test.cjs && node test/artifact/esm.test.mjs && node test/artifact/global.test.cjs
scripts.test:artifact: npm run build && npm run test:artifact:run
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:run
scripts.test:browser:fixme: npm run build && cross-env HARNESS_MODE=fixme playwright test --project=browser
scripts.test:style: npm run build && npm run test:style:run
scripts.test:style:fixme: npm run build && cross-env HARNESS_MODE=fixme playwright test --project=style
scripts.test:jsdom:svonly: cross-env HARNESS=jsdom ENGINE=sx-vendor ONLY=only vitest run --project=jsdom
scripts.test:jsdom:sxonly: cross-env HARNESS=jsdom ENGINE=selectlet ONLY=only vitest run --project=jsdom
scripts.test:jsdom:nwonly: cross-env HARNESS=jsdom ENGINE=nwsapi ONLY=only vitest run --project=jsdom
scripts.test:jsdom:dsonly: cross-env HARNESS=jsdom ENGINE=dom-selector ONLY=only vitest run --project=jsdom
scripts.test:quick: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:unit:run && npm run test:artifact:run && npm run test:jsdom:sv
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:unit:run && npm run test:artifact:run && npm run vendor && npm run install:jsdom:run && npm run test:jsdom:sx && npm run test:jsdom:sv && npm run test:browser:run && npm run test:style:run
